name: Orihime
source:
The astral princess who unites the Cosmic Wraiths. Her wand and cloak are the embodiment of her mighty power, capable of interfering with all laws of the universe. In other words, She is the most powerful being in the universe.

Deep down, she is a pure and innocent girl. She is just a cute little loli who is always yapping and frolicking.
